I think the behaviour system is doing well
17 Oct @ 7:13am
Theodor
Hi,

I saw the other post with complains about the behaviour system. I just wanted to say that I think it's doing fine from the limited game experience I've had so far. I was positively surprised some company managed to implement a system that moderately makes people censor themselves a little bit in terms of toxicity.
Doing that with a scoring system is ingenious. However, I feel like a certain amount and intensity of low behaviour should be punished more strongly, including, say, the incantation for someone else to "go kill himself" and comparable.

I agree with your point about the line between playing badly and actually griefing. Not everyone who loses a lane, makes bad decisions, or isn't comfortable taking fights is ruining the game. That's exactly why reports need to distinguish between bad gameplay and intentional griefing.

I can't say the matchmaking deliberately targets people or manipulates wins and losses, but the report system is still worth questioning on its own.
